**Daily Devotional**

**June 23**

*16 And without controversy great is the mystery of godliness: God was manifest in the flesh, justified in the Spirit, seen of angels, preached unto the Gentiles, believed on in the world, received up into glory. (1 Timothy 3:16 KJV)*

This of course is speaking of Jesus, and is another of many references to Jesus as being God. The divinity of Jesus is spoken of so many times in the Bible, that it is amazing that some religions do not believe it. Paul makes it clear that the mystery of godliness is Christ living in us (Colossians 1:27). It is a mystery to those who are not saved, as Christ indwelling us is impossible for the natural mind to comprehend. You must hear the Gospel of Christ to be saved, as that is how you get faith enough to be saved (Romans 10:17), and you must have faith to please God (Hebrews 11:6).

God was manifest in the flesh as Jesus (John 1:14). He was justified (righteous) in the spirit (1 Peter 2:22). He was seen of angels (Luke 22:43). He was preached unto the Gentiles (Matthew 24:14). Believed on in the world (Romans 10:17). He was received up into glory (heaven) (Acts 1:9-11). Therefore all these things are true of our Lord Jesus, who has purchased our salvation for us, and is our Savior and Lord. He came and died for us, not because we deserve it, but because He is love (1 John 4:16). We were created by Him and for His pleasure (Revelation 4:11), and even though we are far from perfect, He loves us with a divine love that is impossible for carnal man to understand fully. Thank you Jesus for loving us and coming to save us.
